# Locality Guide: Santiago, Chile (c. 1860–1940)

## Jurisdiction overview
- **Formed:** Province of Santiago formed 1826; city of Santiago de Chile founded 1541
- **Administrative center:** Santiago de Chile
- **Parent jurisdiction:** Santiago Metropolitan Region (created 1976); before 1976 = Province of Santiago
- **Population during period:** Province ~341,700 (1865), ~387,100 (1880), ~516,400 (1908), ~967,600 (1930), ~1,268,500 (1940) [Populstat estimates]
- **Religious denominations:** Predominantly Roman Catholic; small Protestant, Jewish, and other communities

## Boundary changes
- Province of Santiago formed 1826; boundaries stable through 1860–1940 window
- Santiago Metropolitan Region created 1976 — post-dates the target period; no effect on record-keeping

## Available record types

### Cemetery records (PRIMARY)
- **Cemeteries in Santiago:** Cementerio General (founded 1821, Prof Alberto Zañartu 951, Recoleta); Cementerio Católico Parroquial (founded 1883, Arzobispo Valdivieso 555); Cementerio Israelita (founded 1938)
- **What records contain:** Name of deceased, date and time of death, place of death, age at death, gender, cause of death, amount paid, family relations; plot location, receipt numbers
- **FamilySearch (primary):** 'Chile, Cemetery Records, 1701-2021' (collection 1428897) — indexed + images, 5,937,792 records, 3,675,058 images. Covers Antofagasta, Santiago, Valparaíso, Viña del Mar. Browse: City → Cemetery → Record Type and Dates
- **FamilySearch Catalog entries (direct browse):** Cementerio General part 1, 1702-2012 (catalog 2062052); part 2, 1800-2012 (catalog 1972637); 1900-2012 (catalog 2072784); Cementerio Católico 1883-2007 (catalog 1459370)
- **Ancestry:** Chile, Santiago, Cementerio General, 1821-2011 (collection 9814) — subscription
- **MyHeritage:** Chile, Santiago Burials (collection 20739) — index & images, subscription
- **Physical:** Cementerio General keeps its own sexton records; online tool for niche burials post-1937 at www.cementeriogeneral.cl

### Vital records (civil registration)
- **Start date:** 1885
- **FamilySearch:** 'Chile, Civil Registration, 1880-1933' (collection 1630787) — indexed + images, 4,609,955 records, 1,623,199 images
- **Also:** Ancestry collection 9812; MyHeritage collection 30168
- **Chilean Civil Registry:** www.registrocivil.cl — persons with RUN can request certificates free
- **Pre-1885 deaths:** Church records only

### Church records
- **Denominations:** Roman Catholic dominant
- **FamilySearch:** 'Chile, Catholic Church Records, 1633-2015' (collection 3405096) — indexed + images, 8,804,944 records; 'Chile, Deaths, 1700-1920' (collection 1520559) — index only, 294,541 records
- **Language:** Spanish (archaic 19th-century forms)
- **Browse-only volumes:** Many parish volumes in FamilySearch have 0% indexing — must be browsed image-by-image

### Census records
- National censuses: 1865, 1875, 1885, 1895, 1907, 1920, 1930, 1940 — limited online availability; useful for confirming residence

### Newspaper records
- **Memoria Chilena** (www.memoriachilena.cl, Biblioteca Nacional de Chile) — digitized historical newspapers; obituaries and death notices may appear

## Repository guide

### Online repositories
| Repository | Key collections | Access |
|---|---|---|
| FamilySearch | Cemetery Records 1701-2021 (1428897); Civil Registration 1880-1933 (1630787); Catholic Church Records 1633-2015 (3405096); Deaths 1700-1920 (1520559) | Free |
| Ancestry | Cementerio General 1821-2011 (9814); Civil Registration 1885-1903 (9812); Deaths 1700-1920 (9810) | Subscription |
| MyHeritage | Santiago Burials (20739); Civil Registration 1885-1903 (30168) | Subscription |
| Memoria Chilena | Historical newspapers and documents | Free |

### Physical repositories
| Repository | Holdings | Access |
|---|---|---|
| Cementerio General de Santiago | Burial registers 1821–present | In-person or www.cementeriogeneral.cl |
| Archivo Nacional de Chile | Civil and notarial records | In-person, Santiago |
| Chilean Civil Registry | Vital records 1885–present | www.registrocivil.cl |
| Instituto Chileno de Investigaciones Genealógicas | Finding aids, compiled genealogies | www.genealogia.cl |

## Records NOT online
- Full sexton ledger books of Cementerio General pre-digitization may require in-person consultation
- Not all Santiago Catholic parish burial books are fully digitized or indexed in FS
- Post-1940 civil registration records are held by the Chilean Civil Registry and not fully available online

## Research tips
1. **Start with FamilySearch collection 1428897** — search by surname 'Gatica' and given name 'Eulojia' (or variants)
2. **Women may be indexed under married name** — if not found under Gatica, determine married name and search again
3. **Browse images** when search fails: collection 1428897 → Browse → Santiago → Cementerio General → date range
4. **Cross-check with civil death record:** collection 1630787 covers deaths 1885–1933 with indexing
5. **MyHeritage Santiago Burials** (20739) offers a complementary index — worth a parallel search
6. **Variant given-name spellings:** Eulojia, Eulogia, Eulalia may all appear in different index entries
7. **All records in Spanish:** defunción = death; entierro = burial; edad = age; año de nacimiento = birth year

Per loc_001: Santiago families used multiple parishes; search across parishes. Fallback if pli_003 index-only search returns nothing.
